attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Hearthguard Compact continues to offer prizes for new inventions.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news as an ongoing status; the briefing gives it only as an earlier item, and 'continues' is banned"},{"span":"It seems they are always looking for something to tinker with.","severity":"minor","reason":"implies an ongoing, habitual activity the briefing does not report"},{"span":"The tribe and the Outlanders shared a meal.","severity":"minor","reason":"restates the feast as a meal; the briefing does not say what was shared"}],"voice":3,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The bulletin breaks the rules by padding with old news: it uses the banned word 'continues' and presents the invention prizes as current. It also ignores the one-new-thing format by running three paragraphs, and the wit is thin. It names the lead item correctly, but the first paragraph has no dry remark and the second just restates the feast."}
